items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex trades flat, Nifty around 23,400; auto, IT shares underperform
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap were trading 0.36 per cent and 0.03 per cent lower, respectively

items.title: Redington shares zoom 6% to fresh high on iPhone Duo, 18 Pro series launch
items.description: Redington shares rallied to a new high after the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro series as the company is an official authorised distributor for Apple products in India.

items.title: Why Jefferies finds Vodafone Idea stock a high-beta turnaround play
items.description: Vodafone Idea share price target: Jefferies has initiated coverage of Vodafone Idea with a 'Buy' rating and set a target price of ₹20, implying a 30 per cent upside from the previous close of ₹15.51.

items.title: Dilip Buildcon gains 12% on Paradip-Raipur LPG pipeline project win
items.description: The company received an LoI for the grant of authorisation to lay, build, operate or expand an LPG pipeline from Paradip in Odisha to Raipur in Chhattisgarh.

items.title: Asian stocks slide as oil tops $100, investors brace for US inflation data
items.description: MSCI's Asia-Pacific index fell 1 per cent, while Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI dropped more than 1 per cent as investors weighed higher oil prices and the outlook for US monetary policy

items.description: Stocks to watch: ICICI Pru AMC, Meesho, Wipro, Shakti Pumps, Hindustan Zinc, Sun Pharma, Bank of Baroda, Axis Bank, MCX, among others, will be in focus today.

items.title: Nifty could edge lower to 23,300; HAL among 3 stock ideas: Ajit Mishra
items.description: Stock ideas for today: The index could now move towards the next support zone of 23,300-23,100, while any recovery is likely to face resistance around 23,600-23,800.
